note: Who may record a PASS that counts, for the `reviewed tip` report (Phase 1: report only; see docs/autonomous-dev.md). A login listed here is not a merge right: the report is read when a tip is judged, and a PASS is required only for T2/T3 (at the tip, with green CI); T0/T1 merge on green CI without one (AGENTS.md step 6). A pull request's own author does not count unless the author is listed in `selfReview` (owner decision 2026-10-19: the owner's Bot/agent, which acts as Birfy, may PASS its own pull requests). A self-PASS never replaces green CI: the agent that gated a T2/T3 pull request merges it itself once a PASS sits at its tip (owner decision 2026-10-21). Editing this file is itself T3.
